description: This Java class defines a PreferenceFragment for managing custom app restrictions within an Android application. It demonstrates handling different input types (checkbox, single-choice, multi-choice), retrieving and saving restriction entries, and integrating with Android's restriction management system.

classes.name: CustomRestrictionsFragment
classes.description: A PreferenceFragment subclass that manages custom app restrictions, allowing users to modify restriction settings and saving these configurations for restricted profiles.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences from XML, sets change listeners, and retains instance state.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves current restrictions, initializes preference UI elements, and prepares the result intent.

methods.name: onPreferenceChange
methods.description: Handles preference value changes, updates restriction entries, and saves the updated restrictions.
